title: Check the caller contract and owner lifetime before repairing a helper
applies_when: An isolated reproduction alleges a missing method decorator, script global, cache-key collision, stale object identity, constant self-comparison, returned-field loss or exception-path resource leak, but omits the full helper implementation, ordered result assembly, interface or owner that invokes it.
lesson: Read the interface, caller and owner lifetime before repairing a helper or installing dependencies. Check descriptors, __main__ initialization and platform predicates; trace strong references, mutation and invalidation. Inspect cleanup and reset/reuse tests beyond the excerpt. Trace ordered spreads and overwrites: skipping a spread does not remove ...result's fields. Test empty/nonempty paths and success controls. Canceled SDK requests can leave an outer retry alive. Failed upload Writers need abort, not a Close that commits partial data; use an upload-owned cancellable context, retain caller authority and successful Close. Invented APIs are feature deltas; static profile matching is not topology support. Use evidence for the next check, not blanket rejection.
avoid_when: A documented public helper can be defective without shipped callers. Strong references prevent identity reuse only during their lifetime, not mutation, stale metadata or concurrency. A cleanup handler or passing suite proves only reached scenarios, not every leak path. Earlier spreads preserve only present enumerable own properties; later undefined values, overwrites or changed producers can lose data. Close semantics vary by resource: do not transfer upload abort to successful caller-owned streams. SDK-internal stack assertions are revision-bound, not stable API guarantees. These scoped counterexamples do not measure accelerator performance or general false-positive rates.

evidence.note: Real GCS SDK/local HTTP: Reader errors before/after a chunk leak Writer monitors; child-context cancellation aborts without partial commit or caller cancellation. Empty/small/multi-chunk success remains. Native/race checks use an SDK-internal stack frame, not live GCS or throughput qualification.

Qiniu/Dragonfly reject 404/416/500 with nil body: callers cannot close the response. Held-open HTTP tests reproduce missing cleanup; rejected-only Close fixes it while 200/206 streams remain caller-owned. Blanket defer would break success. Native/race coverage is local HTTP, not cloud accounts, connection reuse, all statuses or performance.

Coalesced request authority and acknowledgement ownership are independent here. Rejecting a second session's hooks does not revoke its admitted request. Native leaf-class controls cover revocation and one-shot acknowledgement, not actual service restarts or all caller timelines.

archives ?? collectArchivedSources uses an initial snapshot at L469 but reacquires at L477. Unchanged archive-only/missing-source cases agree; a new archive invalidates the old view. Different arguments are deliberate freshness, not forgotten archives. Not full migration/concurrency qualification.
handle_async_request catches BaseException and shields _response_closed; the iterator also closes on exception at L579-585. A StreamReset-only excerpt omits owning cleanup.
The native RST_STREAM test follows rejection with a successful same-connection request, beyond the first 100 lines. Relevant control, not universal semaphore/cancellation proof.

torchrun initializes global rank before join/update_weights call check_sglang_ready. An import-only call or first-120-line excerpt misses the supported entry. Static, not distributed execution evidence.
get_supported_act_dtypes is an abstract instance method regardless of receiver spelling.
The loader calls quant_config's instance; class-only TypeError is not this caller's regression.

forward_extend retains forward_batch in outer metadata while checking identity/resolving the next result. Omitting that reference fabricates id reuse. Revision-bound source evidence, not NPU execution.

Windows sameRuntimeIdentity requires nonzero dev/ino, so activation's self-comparison can fail (identity unavailable). assertPrevious separately checks the retained object after rename. Not dead code; not all filesystem races/platform qualification.

migrated is spread before combined notices. Empty collected.notices preserves migrated.notices. The conditional alone fabricates field loss; ordered-expression evidence, not full Doctor/migration coverage.
The outer catch records plugin/runtime JSON.parse failures, failed step and status=error. Ending at L481 omits it. Static counterexample, not native coverage or ideal diagnostics.
resolve matches shapes then validates capacity; a shape-only supports method cannot replace capacity checks or prove hardware support.
The request permits support-query OR documented fallback plus validated profiles; no invented API mandate or backend-correctness proof.

Real S3 SDK requests stop on cancellation, but ListAll's outer page retry survives. Cancel/deadline/backoff negatives and a transient 503 recovery control test the separate producer lifetime. Proposed narrow fix covers draining receivers and nil failure sentinel; not blocked consumers, token recovery, delimiter/sharded paths or all backends. Native/race tests, no performance claim.

Earlier closed, unmerged pagination proposal already covers retry cancellation plus token recovery/backoff. Do not claim the mechanism is new or ignore prior work; the narrow regression above does not qualify those broader changes.
